response.justification: While the candidate has extensive software development experience across multiple languages and domains, there is no evidence of professional C++ development on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle databases, or fixed-income/capital markets domain expertise — all mandatory requirements for the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Demonstrated expertise in CI/CD, testing, and DevOps practices
Active contributor to open-source projects and technical education
concerns: No visible professional C++ experience on Windows platform
Lacks demonstrated fixed-income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
SQL experience listed but no mention of SQL Server or Oracle in context
